paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: : figure

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets by researcher location over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, labeled from 2012 to 2022, in a linear sequence. The vertical axis indicates the "Number of datasets" and uses an exponential scale with values ranging from 10^0 to 10^2. The chart includes grouped bars for each year, each bar representing a different researcher location as noted in the legend: "Other" (blue), "USA" (orange), "IN" (green), "UK" (red), "IT" (purple), and "DE" (brown). The length of each bar corresponds to the number of datasets. In 2012 and 2013, only the "USA" had the bars above 10^0. In 2014, only "Others" and "USA" had bars above 10^0, similarly, in 2015, only "DE" and "Others" had at least 1 dataset. In 2016, multiple categories had more than 1 dataset; this trend is steadily increasing till 2021, when "Others" had more than 100 datasets. In 2022, the categories are represented with multiple bars of varying heights, with "Other" indicating the highest value. The bars do not appear to be sorted in any particular order beyond the sequential annual progression, and there is no additional emphasis on any specific bars except 2022, which is in light color. A legend is available on the top left of the plot to map different bar colors to their labels.
